zh.title: 達美航空今冬調整網路 砍紐約與拉斯維加斯4條國內航線
zh.summary: 達美航空將於11月與12月停飛紐約JFK、拉瓜地亞與拉斯維加斯4條國內航線。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，達美航空（Delta Air Lines）將於今年冬季調整航線佈局，計畫削減 4 條自紐約甘迺迪國際機場（JFK）、拉瓜地亞機場以及拉斯維加斯出發的美國國內航線。這批航線服務預計將於今年 11 月與 12 月期間正式停止營運。
本次受影響的航點包含來自紐約 JFK、拉瓜地亞與拉斯維加斯的國內航線網絡。達美航空規劃於 11 月與 12 月起停飛相關航線，反映該航空公司針對冬季市場需求所做的航線佈局與運能調整。

en.title: Delta Air Lines Cuts 4 Domestic Routes From New York JFK, LaGuardia & Las Vegas
en.summary: Delta Air Lines will cut four domestic routes from New York JFK, LaGuardia, and Las Vegas this winter.
body: Delta Air Lines is planning to slash four additional domestic routes operating out of New York John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), LaGuardia Airport, and Las Vegas this winter, according to a report by Simple Flying. The carrier's affected domestic flight links are scheduled to disappear during November and December.

The upcoming route cuts target key domestic connections serving the air carrier's hubs in New York and Las Vegas as part of Delta Air Lines' winter schedule adjustments. Operational services across the four domestic routes will be discontinued sequentially throughout the months of November and December.

zh.title: 國防部偵獲21架次共機與10艘共艦 13架次跨越海峽中線
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲21架次共機及10艘共艦；13架次逾越海峽中線；國軍嚴密監控
body: 中華民國國防部發布共機艦動態表示，自2026年9月5日上午6時起至9月6日上午6時止，於台灣周邊海空域偵獲中國軍機21架次、軍艦10艘及公務船5艘。
國防部指出，在偵獲的共機中，有13架次逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾北部、中部、西南及東部空域，持續在台灣海峽周邊活動。國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與應處。
依據本站統計紀錄顯示，前一次於9月4日記錄到的共機艦動態為中國軍機2架次、軍艦5艘及公務船5艘。

en.title: Taiwan MND Tracks 21 Chinese Aircraft and 10 Warships; 13 Cross Median Line
en.summary: Taiwan Ministry of National Defense tracked 21 Chinese aircraft and 10 warships; 13 crossed median line.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported tracking 21 Chinese military aircraft, 10 warships, and 5 official vessels operating around Taiwan between 6:00 AM on September 5 and 6:00 AM on September 6, 2026.

According to defense officials, 13 of the detected aircraft crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering airspace over northern, central, southwestern, and eastern Taiwan. In response, Taiwan's armed forces deployed combat aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and handle the situation.
According to AVWIRE's recorded statistics, the previous tracking record on September 4 registered 2 Chinese aircraft, 5 warships, and 5 official vessels in the area.
